memory_probe.method: sequential warm 200/32 HTTP server, ps RSS and vmmap summary; process footprint excludes GPU allocations and is not a full physical-memory attribution
memory_probe.finding: The opt-in buffer maps the actual pack without application weight upload; these OS summaries cannot prove total GPU/physical memory savings.

worker.note: Startup is construction-to-ready with OS file cache uncontrolled. Graph phase includes synchronization; not shader-only time.

http_sse.note: Two retained servers, serial requests, two warmups per mode, five alternating pairs. SSE counts are established by identical text and finish against the counted nonstream response; SSE does not expose usage.

limits: Two servers coexist in the HTTP/SSE campaign; startup order and memory pressure differ from isolated worker startups.
The worker llama.cpp comparison uses its native driver while Align uses a retained session protocol; the endpoints are not identical.
The mapped file and validated file are opened separately; opt-in use assumes a stable local pack and is not ready for production adoption.
No direct whole-system physical-memory attribution was available.
